note: CONFIRMATION ONLY (no selection) — same rows on the ~100 other coins of s15-universe2. 25/11 (daily run): PRE-REGISTERED before any result — two post-filters on the live ⭐S15 (R2.5 h40 sb0.25 maxRisk15%), applied in the runner after the engine (engine unchanged). (A) CLUSTER: c = number of coins (incl. itself) whose star trade enters at the same 4h bar in the same direction (all signal bars closed together, so known at entry). Hypothesis: an isolated coin-specific sweep is a real liquidity event; many coins sweeping together = a market-wide (BTC) move with correlated risk. Rows: skip if c>=3, skip if c>=5 (neighbour), keep ONLY c>=3 (control, should be worse). (B) LOSS COOLDOWN: skip a coin signal if that coin's previous star trade exited at the initial stop within the last 6 / 12 4h bars (failed reversal = coin is trending). Approximation: a skipped trade does not free the coin for another signal during its life (slightly fewer trades than live). Choose on TRAIN only. Accept a row only if: PF beats the star on BOTH train and test, PF>1.1 in both, fresh not losing, its neighbour row also beats the star on train, the cluster control is worse than the star on train, AND the same row beats the star on train+test in s15-cluster-new (other ~100 coins, confirmation only). 5 filter rows = real chance of a lucky winner.
